allocator.interpretation: Scudo binding and statistics are separate from MTE support. PR_GET_TAGGED_ADDR_CTRL is read-only; no tagging mode or page permissions changed. No reuse, invalid access, mitigation-strength or exploitability experiment.

limitations: LLVM-mapped linked source only; excludes disabled/unlinked paths and third-party dependencies. Counts are not dynamic call edges.
The upstream task is prediction on a supplied valid driver, not generation of branch-complete tests. One matched sample, not a general model comparison.
MTE is not advertised by the local Linux VM; no MTE enforcement claim.
Scudo statistics include runtime/stdio activity and are not isolated application allocation counts; no reuse/address characterization.
